user.title: Rumlys
user.description: Rumlys brings the light in each room together: motion, turn-off times, «keep light on», a schedule with weekdays and scenes. Once the integration is set up, create rooms with «New room» and set them up in Rumlys in the sidebar.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Rumlys is already set up. Create rooms with «New room».

user.title: New room
user.description: Choose the area. The room takes the area's name, and the area's lights and sensors are selected in advance. Areas that already have a room are not listed. The rest is set up in Rumlys in the sidebar.

reconfigure.title: Edit {navn}
reconfigure.description: Lights, schedule and times are edited in [Rumlys in the sidebar]({sti}). Here the room can be moved to another area.

abort.ingen_omraader: Every area already has a room. Create a new area in Home Assistant first.

daemp.name: Dim room
daemp.description: Dims all the room's lights in the same proportion: the brightest gets the brightness and the others follow. 0 turns the room off.

lamper.name: Lights
lamper.description: Only these of the room's lights. Empty: the whole room.

anvend_lys.name: Choose light for room
anvend_lys.description: Turns the room's lights on with a light choice: white light, colour, scene or brightness only. The room remembers it as the chosen light.

lamper.name: Lights
lamper.description: Only these of the room's lights. Empty: the whole room.

anvend_scene.name: Choose scene for room
anvend_scene.description: Turns the room's lights on with a scene. The room remembers it as the chosen light.

lamper.name: Lights
lamper.description: Only these of the room's lights. Empty: the whole room.

hold.name: Keep the light on
hold.description: Keeps the room's light on for the hold time and suspends the sensor and the countdowns. If the light is off, it is turned on.

lamper.name: Lights
lamper.description: Only these of the room's lights are turned on if the light is off. The hold applies to the whole room.

til.name: On
til.description: Turn the hold on or off.

lamper_ikke_i_rummet.message: None of the lights belong to the room «{rum}».
